title: primary mammary tumor, pre-treatment, Patient1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded slides from diagnostic biopsies were cut with a depth of 4 µm. Delimitation of the tumoral zone was done by the pathologist after HE staining on one slide, and reported on the other slides. On average, the tumoral zones of 15-20 slides were scratched.
extract_protocol_ch1: deparaffinization and extraction steps were carried out using the AllPrep DNA/RNA FFPE kit (#80234, Qiagen), according to manufacturer’s recommendations and DNA was removed from the samples with the TURBO DNA-free™ kit (#AM1907, Thermo Fisher Scientific), by following manufacturer’s instructions. Total RNA samples were then quantified by using Quant-it™ RiboGreen RNA Assay kit (#R11490, Thermo Fisher Scientific
extract_protocol_ch1_2: ribosomal RNA depletion were performed with the NEBNext rRNA Depletion kit (Human/Mouse/Rat) with sample purification beads (#E6350, New England Biolabs). Libraries were prepared with the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep with Beads kit (#E7765, New England Biolabs). Adaptors and primers used for the library preparation were from NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina (Dual Index Set 1), 96 rxns (#E7760, New England Biolabs). The quality of the libraries was evaluated using High Sensitivity DNA kit (chips and reagents) (#5067 and #4626, Agilent) with a 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent). Sequence reads were generated on the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencer, on an S4 cartridge (300 bp). RNA sequencing was performed in 3 distinct batches
extract_protocol_ch1_3: bulk stranded total RNA sequencing after depletion of rRNA. Paired-end, 2 x 150bp.
data_processing: The CLC Genomics v22 software (Qiagen) is used to remove low-quality reads from raw NGS sequences, perform trimming and mapping to the Homo sapiens genome hg38 and the RNA database v91
data_processing_2: Supplementary files format and content: the processed datafile is containing the raw counts of reads. The colums are Gene Names, Chromosomes, coordinates, ensembl identifiers, and raw counts for each of the 122 libraries

extract_protocol_ch1: deparaffinization and extraction steps were carried out using the AllPrep DNA/RNA FFPE kit (#80234, Qiagen), according to manufacturer’s recommendations and DNA was removed from the samples with the TURBO DNA-free™ kit (#AM1907, Thermo Fisher Scientific), by following manufacturer’s instructions. Total RNA samples were then quantified by using Quant-it™ RiboGreen RNA Assay kit (#R11490, Thermo Fisher Scientific
extract_protocol_ch1_2: ribosomal RNA depletion were performed with the NEBNext rRNA Depletion kit (Human/Mouse/Rat) with sample purification beads (#E6350, New England Biolabs). Libraries were prepared with the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep with Beads kit (#E7765, New England Biolabs). Adaptors and primers used for the library preparation were from NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina (Dual Index Set 1), 96 rxns (#E7760, New England Biolabs). The quality of the libraries was evaluated using High Sensitivity DNA kit (chips and reagents) (#5067 and #4626, Agilent) with a 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent). Sequence reads were generated on the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencer, on an S4 cartridge (300 bp). RNA sequencing was performed in 3 distinct batches
extract_protocol_ch1_3: bulk stranded total RNA sequencing after depletion of rRNA. Paired-end, 2 x 150bp.
data_processing: The CLC Genomics v22 software (Qiagen) is used to remove low-quality reads from raw NGS sequences, perform trimming and mapping to the Homo sapiens genome hg38 and the RNA database v91
data_processing_2: Supplementary files format and content: the processed datafile is containing the raw counts of reads. The colums are Gene Names, Chromosomes, coordinates, ensembl identifiers, and raw counts for each of the 122 libraries
